difficulty_reason: Build the map s(F(K)) -> RGamma(X,F) and the spectral sequence with E_2^{p,q} = Cech^p(K, underline H^q(F)) converging to H^{p+q}(X,F) by a double complex argument: choose an injective resolution F -> I^bullet, form A^{p,q} = I^q(K_p) with d_1 from the cosimplicial differential on s(I^q(K)) and d_2 from the resolution differential, and totalize; lemma-injective-trivial-cech makes each row s(I^q(K)) acyclic in positive degrees with H^0 = I^q(X), so I^bullet(X) -> Tot(A) is a quasi-isomorphism (homology-lemma-double-complex-gives-resolution) and defines the map of the lemma since I^bullet(X) represents RGamma(X,F); the 'E spectral sequence has 'E_1^{p,q} = underline H^q(F)(K_p) hence 'E_2^{p,q} = Cech^p(K, underline H^q(F)), converging to H^n(X,F) by the first-quadrant lemma.
